subject: Zone provenance & private deployment runbook request
messages:
From: Elise Moreno <elise.moreno@wellbridge.health>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
Cc: Oliver Chan <oliver.chan@wellbridge.health>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 11 Sep 2025 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: EU-only hosting proof + private deploy controls

Hi Michael,

Thanks for the conversation earlier this week. As part of our vendor security intake and the upcoming SIG/CAIQ review, the InfoSec team has a short list of evidence items we need to sign off on to complete WellBridge's procurement checklist: 

- Confirmation that production customer workloads for WellBridge will be served from EU-only compute (no cross-border fallback paths).
- VPC topology diagram showing private endpoints, peering, and bastion/management access model.
- KMS key partitioning/ownership matrix (who holds master keys, rotation cadence).
- SOC 2 summary (scope + date) and recent CAIQ/SIG answers or indicatives.
- A short bastion/runbook describing how on-call or support access is granted for private deployments.

Can you share these or point me to a consolidated evidence packet? If helpful, we can set a 30-minute walkthrough for your ops team + our InfoSec. We are aiming to finish the review by Sep 25.

Appreciate it — Elise
Elise Moreno
Sr. Security PM, WellBridge Health
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
To: Elise Moreno <elise.moreno@wellbridge.health>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Sep 2025 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: EU-only hosting proof + private deploy controls

Hi Elise — thanks for the clear list. I can get you the SOC 2 summary and a consolidated packet this week. Looping in Monica (CS ops) and Marissa (residency & compliance lead) to prepare the VPC diagram + KMS matrix and the bastion runbook.

Monica / Marissa — can you confirm who owns the bastion runbook and whether the EU-only compute assertion requires any additional contractual language? If you have a shared Drive pack I can send to Elise.

I can also host a 30-minute walkthrough on Wed 17th if that works for your team.

—Michael
Michael Grant
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Sep 2025 10:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: EU-only hosting proof + private deploy controls

Thanks Michael — taking point. Quick status: 

- SOC 2 summary: already available (we'll attach PDF). Scope covers hosted and dedicated; Private deployments are included where the customer requests managed control plane.
- EU-only compute: Our private deployments can be constrained to EU regions with routing rules and smart routing disabled for that tenant. We have an operational guardrail that prohibits cross-region fallback unless explicitly enabled in the tenant policy.
- VPC topology: I have a diagram draft showing the private endpoints + peering; it includes the bastion/workflow.
- KMS: Irene — can you confirm whether we produce the separation matrix (customer-managed CMKs vs Redwood-managed keys) as a CSV export?
- Bastion runbook: We maintain a runbook (internal) that covers ephemeral access via just-in-time (JIT) jump hosts and recorded sessions. We will produce a redacted customer-facing runbook that omits internal operator identities.

Action items for us: produce a consolidated evidence packet (vpc-topology-eu-zone.png, kms-separation-matrix.csv, privatedeploy-bastion-runbook.md, soc2-summary-2025.pdf). Target to deliver to Elise by Sep 18 COB.

Monica
Monica Patel
Customer Solutions, Redwood Inference
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Sep 2025 14:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: EU-only hosting proof + private deploy controls

Monica — confirmed. We can export the KMS partitioning matrix; it will show: 

- customer_cmk_id (when customer uses their own CMK)
- redwood_key_id (when Redwood manages the key)
- key_owner (customer | redwood)
- rotation_policy_days
- region_restriction (EU-only flag)

I'll scrub any operator usernames and produce a CSV. For the bastion runbook I will prepare a customer-facing summary that documents: approval workflow (SRE on-call + customer approver), session recording retention (30 days by default, adjustable), and JIT key issuance window (15 minutes typical).

Irene
Irene Choi
Staff SRE, Redwood Inference
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
To: Elise Moreno <elise.moreno@wellbridge.health>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 18 Sep 2025 08:54:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: EU-only hosting proof + private deploy controls

Elise — attaching the first pass evidence packet for WellBridge: 

Attachments (redacted for sharing):
- redwood_soc2-summary-2025.pdf (SOC 2 scope + last audit date) [Attachment: redwood_soc2-summary-2025.pdf]
- vpc-topology-eu-zone.png (diagram of private endpoints, peering and management path) [Attachment: vpc-topology-eu-zone.png]
- kms-separation-matrix.csv (redacted matrix showing CMK ownership and region flags) [Attachment: kms-separation-matrix.csv]
- privatedeploy-bastion-runbook.md (customer-facing summary of bastion access and JIT process) [Attachment: privatedeploy-bastion-runbook.md]

High-level notes: 
- EU-only compute: For private deployments we will pin compute to EU regions and apply a tenant-level policy that disables cross-region fallback. This is enforced at the routing/orchestration layer; network egress to non-EU is blocked unless customer explicitly requests a specific fallback route in writing.
- KMS: Customer-managed CMKs are supported; Redwood-managed keys can be restricted by region. The attached CSV indicates per-tenant key owner and whether the key is region-restricted.
- Bastion access: JIT access via ephemeral bastion with recorded sessions. The runbook outlines approvers, session retention, and the support channel workflow.

If you want, we can walk through the packet on a quick call. We also have a short CAIQ/SIG extract that Marissa will prepare if your auditors need the questionnaire mapping.

Thanks —Michael
[Attachment: redwood_soc2-summary-2025.pdf] [Attachment: vpc-topology-eu-zone.png] [Attachment: kms-separation-matrix.csv] [Attachment: privatedeploy-bastion-runbook.md]
From: Elise Moreno <elise.moreno@wellbridge.health>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
Cc: Oliver Chan <oliver.chan@wellbridge.health>, Veritas Audit Team <soc2-audits@veritas-audit.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Sep 2025 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: EU-only hosting proof + private deploy controls

Michael / team — thank you, this is exactly what we needed to progress. Quick follow-ups from InfoSec/auditors: 

1) Can you add a brief appendix in the runbook that lists the exact retention period for bastion session recordings and the mechanism for audit retrieval?
2) The KMS CSV is great — can you add a column that explicitly flags "no-export" for keys that cannot be exported from EU nodes?
3) Would Marissa be able to produce the SIG/CAIQ extract for our auditors (Veritas)? They asked for a mapping table to your controls.

If you can get the above by EOD Sep 19 we can lock this in before our procurement committee meeting on Sep 22. Happy to join a 20-minute call if needed.

Appreciate the fast turnaround — Elise

[WellBridge Health — InfoSec]
